method: Reviewed the complete lesson, registered checkpoints and sources. Rechecked exact PyPI JSON metadata for langgraph 1.2.14 and langchain 0.3.7, pip dependency-resolution/install-report documentation, PyPA packaging Version docs, and OpenTelemetry semantic convention guidance. Ran the retained verifier and a new W6 boundary/output verifier; extracted and executed the complete Python fence with Python 3.10.9 and packaging 24.2.
limitations: Exact release metadata proves declared requirements for the two pinned PyPI releases, not what the historical pip command installed.
The sample compares direct constraints against a fixed snapshot; it does not resolve transitive requirements, environment markers, extras, platform tags, or pip upgrade behavior.
No target-project requirements dry run was run because no representative target project input was selected for this check.
No specific observability platform pricing, retention, access control, integrations, or production telemetry behavior was tested.
Historical trace experiment data remain unavailable and unreproduced.
